description: Click an element by ref. Refuses with a reason (obscured, stale, not visible) instead of clicking the wrong thing. Returns evidence of what changed.

escalate.description: With snapshot:false: print the page anyway if the expectation is unmet or ambiguous, or on a dialog, new tab, unexpected page, refused write, invalid field or page still loading.

expect.description: What this should bring about: text shown / gone (in element `in`, else the page), url containing a part; within seconds (default 3). The reply says MATCHED, UNMET, ALREADY HELD (true before too) or AMBIGUOUS (why): a page state, not proof the task succeeded.

in.description: From the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12" or "f1e3"

ref.description: From the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12" or "f1e3"

snapshot.description: Default true. false: no page snapshot in the result, only the evidence (what changed, was added or removed) and notes; for a next step that reads with browser_query or browser_get_text, or more steps before one look. browser_snapshot shows the screen at any time.

name: browser_click
title: Click
